overview:
**Fire danger is Moderate today, kept in check by overnight rain and milder fuels, with a drop to Low expected starting Sunday.**
- Trend: danger eases from Moderate today to Low for the rest of the week as ERC/BI percentiles fall into the 30s-40s.
- Weather driver: showers and thunderstorms are moving through today and tonight, with ENE winds 5-20 mph (gusts to 35 mph) per NWS.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met; no Red Flag Warning or other alerts are active for this area.
- Restrictions: No fire restrictions are currently in effect in these counties — Gunnison, Ouray, and GMUG National Forest Stage 1 orders were all rescinded in September.
- Incidents: No active wildfires are reported in or near Montrose-area counties; the only uncontained large fire in today's national sit report is in Wyoming, outside this area.
